# Licence of the files in this folder (test/fixtures/odbl/)

`overture-water-slice.json` holds the raw bytes of two column chunks (`subtype` and
`names.common.key_value.key`) of one row group of the Overture Maps Foundation's water data,
release 2026-09-23.1, for testing the Parquet reader in tools/map/parquet.mjs on real data.
